# stage API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Explicit Dialog, Drawer and Popover surfaces sharing one caller-owned content structure.

## Stage

Present one composed content structure in a Dialog, Drawer or anchored Popover.
Use Header, Body and optional Footer in declared order; a caller-owned form wrapper
may contain all three. Presentation is explicit and latched for each open session.
Strings in Header stay literal with toolkit presets; caller JSX remains unchanged.
Requires shared Fluent theme/renderer, but no SPFx provider. Controlled consumers
accept or refuse requests by updating open; native event prevention is not a callback veto.

### Imports

```ts
import { Stage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { Stage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { Stage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/stage';
```

### Use when

- One explicit modal or anchored presentation must host the same structured content.

### Avoid when

- An open surface must switch immediately between presentation modes as the viewport changes; Stage latches presentation until the next session.

### Form ownership and pending work

Put the same-suite Form.Root inside the portaled surface so Body fields and Footer Submit share one native DOM form. React context from an outer Root alone cannot establish DOM form ownership. Submit through the suite's Root/Submit gate; direct methods.handleSubmit bypasses that gate. Read proxied isDirty/isSubmitting during rendering before callbacks use them. Await application persistence before resetting the baseline and closing. Keep close requests controlled while pending, and show inline discard confirmation rather than nesting a modal. Stage itself has no RHF dependency.

### Throws

- Error - Presentation/size is invalid, full Popover is requested, or state ownership changes during a mount.

### Examples

#### Basic Stage composition

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Stage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/stage';

<Stage presentation="dialog" trigger={<button type="button">Edit</button>}>
  <Stage.Header title="Profile" closeLabel="Close" />
  <Stage.Body><input aria-label="Name" /></Stage.Body>
  <Stage.Footer><button type="button">Save</button></Stage.Footer>
</Stage>
```

#### Profile editor with native Form ownership

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, Stage, useSx, alignItems, flex, flexItem, justifyContent, minHeight, width, gap } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

const Editor = createForm<{ name: string }>();

export function ProfileEditor({ saveProfile }: { saveProfile: (values: { name: string }) => Promise<void> }): React.ReactElement {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [discardRequested, setDiscardRequested] = React.useState(false);
  const methods = Editor.useForm({ defaultValues: { name: '' } });
  // Read during render to subscribe to RHF's proxied formState before callbacks use it.
  const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = methods.formState;
  const sx = useSx();
  return <Stage presentation="dialog" open={open}
    trigger={<button type="button">Edit profile</button>}
    onOpenChange={(_, data) => {
      if (!data.open && isSubmitting) return;
      if (!data.open && isDirty) { setDiscardRequested(true); return; }
      setOpen(data.open);
    }}>
    <Editor.Root methods={methods}
      className={sx(flex.column, flexItem.grow, minHeight.zero, width.full, gap.medium)}
      onSubmit={async values => {
        await saveProfile(values);
        methods.reset(values);
        setDiscardRequested(false);
        setOpen(false);
      }}>
      <Stage.Header title="Profile" closeLabel="Close" />
      <Stage.Body>
        <Editor.Input name="name" label="Display name" />
        {discardRequested && <div role="status">
          Discard changes?
          <button type="button" disabled={isSubmitting} onClick={() => {
            methods.reset(); setDiscardRequested(false); setOpen(false);
          }}>Discard</button>
          <button type="button" disabled={isSubmitting} onClick={() => setDiscardRequested(false)}>Keep editing</button>
        </div>}
      </Stage.Body>
      <Stage.Footer className={sx(flex.row, flex.wrap, alignItems.center, justifyContent.end, gap.small)}>
        <Editor.Submit appearance="primary">Save</Editor.Submit>
      </Stage.Footer>
    </Editor.Root>
  </Stage>;
}
```

#### Edit a report with guarded Stage dismissal

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Checkbox, Field, Select, Button,
  Input, makeStyles,
} from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { ArrowRight20Regular, Info24Regular } from '@fluentui/react-icons';
import {
  Stage, alignItems, createForm, flex, flexItem, gap, justifyContent, minHeight, minWidth, text, useSx, width,
} from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type {
  StageDismissMode, StageOpenChangeData, StageOpenChangeEvent, StagePresentation, StageProps, StageSize,
} from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface Draft {
  name: string;
  category: string;
}
const Editor = createForm<Draft>();
const defaults: Draft = { name: 'Quarterly report', category: 'one' };
const useStyles = makeStyles({
  instance: { minInlineSize: '0' },
  form: { alignSelf: 'stretch', overflow: 'hidden' },
  output: { overflowWrap: 'anywhere' },
  narrowField: { minInlineSize: 0 },
});

type DemoRegions = {
  controls?: React.ReactNode; commands?: React.ReactNode; status?: React.ReactNode;
  diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; children?: React.ReactNode;
};
const standalone = (regions: DemoRegions): React.ReactElement => <>
  {regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}
</>;
type ResetFocusIntent = { owner: Document; source: HTMLButtonElement; trigger?: HTMLButtonElement };
const SurfaceNote: React.FC<{ revision: number }> = ({ revision }) => {
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState('Session note');
  const previous = React.useRef(revision);
  React.useEffect(() => { if (previous.current !== revision) { previous.current = revision; setValue('Session note'); } }, [revision]);
  return <Input aria-label="Surface note" input={{ as: 'input', ...{ 'data-stage-demo': 'surface-note' } }} value={value} onChange={(_, data) => setValue(data.value)} />;
};
export function Demo({ render = standalone, resetRevision = 0 }: {
  render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement; resetRevision?: number;
}): React.ReactElement {
  const instance = 'A';
  const sx = useSx();
  const styles = useStyles();
  const titleSlotRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLSpanElement>(), []);
  const triggerRef = React.useMemo(() => React.createRef<HTMLButtonElement>(), []);
  const [slotObservation, setSlotObservation] = React.useState('not inspected');
  const controlWidth = sx(minWidth.zero, width.full);
  const narrowField = sx(styles.narrowField, minWidth.zero, width.full);
  const methods = Editor.useForm({ defaultValues: defaults });
  // Read during render to subscribe to RHF's formState proxy updates.
  const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = methods.formState;
  const [presentation, setPresentation] = React.useState<StagePresentation>('dialog');
  const [size, setSize] = React.useState<StageSize>('small');
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [longBody, setLongBody] = React.useState(false);
  const [longText, setLongText] = React.useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState('Report details');
  const [descriptionValue, setDescriptionValue] = React.useState('Update the document title and category.');
  const titleText = longText ? `Profile ${instance}: long literal title that must retain its accessible text while truncating visually. `.repeat(8) : title;
  const descriptionText = longText ? 'Long literal supporting description that keeps its full accessible content while using at most two visual lines. '.repeat(20) : descriptionValue;
  const [jsx, setJsx] = React.useState(false);
  const [icon, setIcon] = React.useState(true);
  const [description, setDescription] = React.useState(true);
  const [customStrings, setCustomStrings] = React.useState(false);
  const [closeButton, setCloseButton] = React.useState(true);
  const [footer, setFooter] = React.useState(true);
  const [retain, setRetain] = React.useState(false);
  const [dismissMode, setDismissMode] = React.useState<StageDismissMode>('standard');
  const [withArrow, setWithArrow] = React.useState(false);
  const [guardDirty, setGuardDirty] = React.useState(true);
  const [holdSave, setHoldSave] = React.useState(false);
  const [discard, setDiscard] = React.useState(false);
  const [request, setRequest] = React.useState('No request');
  const [status, setStatus] = React.useState('Not saved');
  const [saveCount, setSaveCount] = React.useState(0);
  const [openCount, setOpenCount] = React.useState(0);
  const [actionCount, setActionCount] = React.useState(0);
  const pendingSave = React.useRef<(() => void) | undefined>(undefined);
  const generation = React.useRef(0);
  const active = React.useRef(true);
  const previousReset = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  const resetFocus = React.useRef<ResetFocusIntent | undefined>(undefined);
  const [resetPending, setResetPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [contentRevision, setContentRevision] = React.useState(0);
  const requestReset = React.useCallback((source?: HTMLButtonElement): void => {
    resetFocus.current = source ? { owner: source.ownerDocument, source, trigger: triggerRef.current ?? undefined } : undefined;
    generation.current += 1;
    setOpen(false);
    setResetPending(true);
    pendingSave.current?.();
    pendingSave.current = undefined;
  }, [triggerRef]);
  React.useEffect(() => () => {
    resetFocus.current = undefined;
    active.current = false;
    generation.current += 1;
    pendingSave.current?.();
    pendingSave.current = undefined;
  }, []);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (previousReset.current === resetRevision) return;
    previousReset.current = resetRevision;
    requestReset();
  }, [resetRevision, requestReset]);
  // Drain the real Form.Root submission gate before resetting RHF or permitting a new session.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!resetPending || isSubmitting) return;
    methods.reset(defaults);
    setPresentation('dialog'); setSize('small'); setLongBody(false); setLongText(false);
    setTitle('Report details'); setDescriptionValue('Update the document title and category.');
    setJsx(false); setIcon(true); setDescription(true); setCustomStrings(false);
    setCloseButton(true); setFooter(true); setRetain(false); setDismissMode('standard');
    setWithArrow(false); setGuardDirty(true); setHoldSave(false); setDiscard(false);
    setRequest('No request'); setStatus('Not saved'); setSaveCount(0); setOpenCount(0); setActionCount(0);
    setSlotObservation('not inspected'); setContentRevision(value => value + 1); setResetPending(false);
  }, [resetPending, isSubmitting, methods]);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (resetPending || isSubmitting || open) return;
    const intent = resetFocus.current;
    if (!intent) return;
    resetFocus.current = undefined;
    const target = triggerRef.current, owner = intent.owner;
    // Reset can replace a Drawer/Popover trigger when the closed baseline becomes Dialog.
    // Native restoration cannot target that disconnected button. Repair only this explicit
    // in-surface Reset intent; same-node Dialog and ordinary close remain native-owned.
    if (!active.current || !target?.isConnected || target === intent.trigger || target.disabled ||
      target.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || target.ownerDocument !== owner) return;
    const frame = owner.defaultView?.frameElement;
    if (frame && frame.ownerDocument.activeElement !== frame) return;
    const focused = owner.activeElement;
    // A newer connected destination wins, including the global Reset/navigation controls.
    if (focused === owner.body || focused === intent.source || focused === intent.trigger) target.focus();
  }, [resetPending, isSubmitting, open, presentation, triggerRef]);
  React.useEffect(() => { if (open) setOpenCount(value => value + 1); }, [open]);
  const onOpenChange = (_event: StageOpenChangeEvent, data: StageOpenChangeData): void => {
    if (resetPending) return;
    setRequest(`${data.reason}: ${String(data.open)}`);
    if (!data.open && isSubmitting) {
      setStatus('Close refused: save pending');
      return;
    }
    if (!data.open && guardDirty && isDirty) {
      setDiscard(true);
      setStatus('Close refused: unsaved changes');
      return;
    }
    setDiscard(false);
    setOpen(data.open);
  };
  const requestClose = (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>): void => {
    onOpenChange(event, { open: false, reason: 'closeButton' });
  };
  // Capture the submission epoch before RHF can defer invoking this callback.
  const submissionGeneration = generation.current;
  const save = async (value: Draft): Promise<void> => {
    const currentGeneration = submissionGeneration;
    if (!active.current || currentGeneration !== generation.current) return;
    setSaveCount(count => count + 1);
    setStatus('Saving');
    if (holdSave) {
      await new Promise<void>(resolve => { pendingSave.current = resolve; });
      if (currentGeneration === generation.current) pendingSave.current = undefined;
    }
    if (!active.current || currentGeneration !== generation.current) return;
    methods.reset(value);
    setDiscard(false);
    setStatus(`Saved ${value.name}`);
  };
  const changePresentation = (value: string): void => {
    if (value !== 'dialog' && value !== 'drawer' && value !== 'popover') return;
    if (value === 'popover' && size === 'full') setSize('small');
    setPresentation(value);
  };
  const trigger = <Button type="button" ref={triggerRef} data-stage-demo="trigger" disabled={resetPending || isSubmitting} appearance="primary">Open editor</Button>;
  const surfaceOptions: Extract<StageProps, { open: boolean }> = presentation === 'popover'
    ? { presentation, size: size === 'full' ? 'small' : size, withArrow, trigger, open, children: undefined }
    : { presentation, size, trigger, open, children: undefined };

  return <section data-stage-demo="panel"><section data-stage-demo="instance" data-stage-instance={instance} className={sx(styles.instance, flex.column, gap.medium)}>
    {render({ controls: <>
      <Field label="Presentation"><Select data-demo-variant="Presentation" data-stage-demo="mode" value={presentation} disabled={open} onChange={event => changePresentation(event.target.value)}>
        <option value="dialog">Dialog</option><option value="drawer">Drawer</option><option value="popover">Popover</option>
      </Select></Field>
      <Field label="Size"><Select data-stage-demo="size" value={size} onChange={event => {
        const value = event.target.value;
        if (value === 'small' || value === 'medium' || value === 'large' || (value === 'full' && presentation !== 'popover')) setSize(value);
      }}>
        <option value="small">Small</option><option value="medium">Medium</option><option value="large">Large</option>
        {presentation !== 'popover' && <option value="full">Full</option>}
      </Select></Field>
      <Field label="Title"><Input input={{ as: 'input', ...{ 'data-stage-demo': 'title' } }} value={title} onChange={(_, data) => setTitle(data.value)} /></Field>
      <Field label="Description"><Input input={{ as: 'input', ...{ 'data-stage-demo': 'description-input' } }} value={descriptionValue} onChange={(_, data) => setDescriptionValue(data.value)} /></Field>
    </>, commands: undefined, status: <>
    <output data-stage-demo="status">{status}</output>
    <output data-stage-demo="open">Open: {String(open)}</output>
    </>, diagnostics: <>
      <Field label="Dismiss"><Select data-stage-demo="dismiss" value={dismissMode} onChange={event => setDismissMode(event.target.value === 'explicit' ? 'explicit' : 'standard')}>
        <option value="standard">Standard</option><option value="explicit">Explicit</option>
      </Select></Field>
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="long-body" label="Long body" checked={longBody} onChange={(_, data) => setLongBody(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="jsx" label="JSX title/description" checked={jsx} onChange={(_, data) => setJsx(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="long-text" label="Long title and description" checked={longText} onChange={(_, data) => setLongText(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="icon" label="Icon" checked={icon} onChange={(_, data) => setIcon(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="description" label="Description" checked={description} onChange={(_, data) => setDescription(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="strings" label="Custom close text" checked={customStrings} onChange={(_, data) => setCustomStrings(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="close" label="Header X" checked={closeButton} onChange={(_, data) => setCloseButton(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="footer-toggle" label="Footer" checked={footer} onChange={(_, data) => setFooter(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="retention" label="Retain after close" checked={retain} onChange={(_, data) => setRetain(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="arrow-toggle" label="Popover arrow" checked={withArrow} disabled={presentation !== 'popover'} onChange={(_, data) => setWithArrow(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="dirty-guard" label="Guard unsaved changes" checked={guardDirty} onChange={(_, data) => setGuardDirty(data.checked === true)} />
      <Checkbox data-stage-demo="hold-save" label="Complete save manually" checked={holdSave} onChange={(_, data) => setHoldSave(data.checked === true)} />
      <Button data-stage-demo="inspect-slot" onClick={() => setSlotObservation(titleSlotRef.current?.tagName ?? 'absent')}>Inspect title</Button><output data-stage-demo="slot-observation">{slotObservation}</output>

    <output data-stage-demo="request" className={styles.output}>{request}</output>
    <output data-stage-demo="save-count">Save callbacks: {saveCount}</output>
    <output data-stage-demo="mount-count">Open sessions: {openCount}</output>
    </>, children: <Stage {...surfaceOptions} open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange} dismissMode={dismissMode} unmountOnClose={!retain}
      data-stage-demo="surface" data-stage-instance={instance}>
      <Editor.Root methods={methods} onSubmit={save} data-stage-demo="form"
        className={sx(styles.form, flex.column, flexItem.grow, minHeight.zero, width.full, gap.medium)}>
        <Stage.Header data-stage-demo="header" title={{ ref: titleSlotRef, 'data-stage-demo': 'title-slot', children: jsx ? <em data-stage-demo="jsx-title">{titleText}</em> : titleText }}
          description={description ? (jsx ? <span data-stage-demo="jsx-description">Editable <strong>profile</strong></span> : descriptionText) : undefined}
          icon={icon ? { children: (Tag, props) => <Tag {...props}><Info24Regular data-stage-demo="callback-icon" width={80} height={80} /></Tag> } : undefined} showCloseButton={closeButton} strings={customStrings ? { closeLabel: `Dismiss ${instance}` } : undefined} closeLabel={customStrings ? undefined : `Close ${instance}`}
          action={{ children: (Tag, props) => <Tag {...props} data-stage-demo="action-slot">
            <Button type="button" className={sx(minWidth.zero)} icon={<ArrowRight20Regular />} data-stage-demo="header-action" onClick={() => setActionCount(value => value + 1)}>
              <span className={sx(minWidth.zero, text.truncate)}>Share</span>
            </Button>
          </Tag> }} />
        <Stage.Body data-stage-demo="body">
          <div className={sx(flex.column, gap.medium)}>
            <Editor.Input name="name" label="Document title" data-stage-demo="name"
              className={narrowField} root={{ className: controlWidth }} input={{ className: sx(minWidth.zero) }} />
            <div data-stage-demo="combobox"><Editor.Combobox name="category" label="Category"
              className={narrowField} root={{ className: controlWidth }} input={{ className: sx(minWidth.zero) }}
              options={[{ value: 'one', label: 'Report' }, { value: 'two', label: 'Project' }]} /></div>
            <SurfaceNote revision={contentRevision} />
            <Button type="button" data-stage-demo="reset-editor" onClick={event => requestReset(event.currentTarget)}>Reset editor</Button>
            <output data-stage-demo="dirty">Dirty: {String(isDirty)}</output>
            <output data-stage-demo="pending">Pending: {String(isSubmitting)}</output>
            {isSubmitting && <Button type="button" data-stage-demo="complete-save" onClick={() => pendingSave.current?.()}>Complete save</Button>}
            <output data-stage-demo="action-count">Header actions: {actionCount}</output>
            {discard && <div role="status" data-stage-demo="discard-prompt">
              <p>Discard unsaved changes?</p>
              <Button type="button" data-stage-demo="discard" disabled={isSubmitting} onClick={() => {
                methods.reset(); setDiscard(false); setOpen(false); setStatus('Discarded changes');
              }}>Discard and close</Button>
              <Button type="button" data-stage-demo="keep-editing" onClick={() => setDiscard(false)}>Keep editing</Button>
            </div>}
            {!footer && <Button type="button" data-stage-demo="body-close" onClick={requestClose}>Close editor</Button>}
            {longBody && Array.from({ length: 35 }, (_, index) => <p key={index}>Scrollable profile note {index + 1}. Header and footer remain available while this body scrolls.</p>)}
          </div>
        </Stage.Body>
        {footer && <Stage.Footer data-stage-demo="footer" className={sx(flex.row, flex.wrap, alignItems.center, justifyContent.end, gap.small)}>
          <Editor.Submit data-stage-demo="save" appearance="primary">Save</Editor.Submit>
          <Button type="button" data-stage-demo="footer-close" onClick={requestClose}>Close editor</Button>
        </Stage.Footer>}
      </Editor.Root>
    </Stage> })}
  </section></section>;
}

export const demo = {
  host: 'none', kind: 'snapshot', contentPlacement: 'configuration',
  observe: 'Edit the report in each presentation; dirty or pending saves refuse dismissal, and accepted closes restore the native trigger focus.',
};
```

## StageCommonProps.onOpenChange

Called once per permitted interaction with the event and requested `{ open, reason }`.
Explicit-dismissal filtering and cancelled trigger clicks produce no notification.
Retain controlled `open` to veto; uncontrolled state updates before notification.
Returned promises are not awaited; omission keeps uncontrolled behavior functional.
Calling preventDefault here does not veto; consumer trigger cancellation is respected separately.
When omitted, no application notification runs; uncontrolled state requests still update normally.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Signatures (5)

```ts
(event: StageOpenChangeEvent, data: StageOpenChangeData): void
```

#### Parameters (9)

- `event`: Native/React interaction event accompanying the notification.
- `data`: Requested next open state and normalized reason. A controlled consumer accepts by updating open or refuses by retaining it; uncontrolled state updates before notification.

## StageHeaderProps

Header div attributes and named content slots; strings are literal, JSX is preserved.
Named props accept shorthand, fixed-tag native props or children render callbacks.
Objects request inner containers; refs identify those containers, not the heading or ID shell.
Callbacks receive the fixed tag/composed props during rendering and must forward the props.
Empty static descriptions do not register naming; Close remains outside consumer action.
Direct strings and props-object string children are visually limited to one title line
or two description lines with ellipsis; full text remains in the DOM for naming.
JSX and render callbacks keep caller-owned presentation in every Stage variant.
The title must be nonempty phrasing content without nested headings.

### Imports (9)

```ts
import type { StageHeaderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { StageHeaderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { StageHeaderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/stage';
```

Native attributes/ref target the outer div; the neutral inner Card isolates selectable ancestor Card context without enabling interaction styling. Use singular action; the removed actions name is not supported. Close remains separately owned and reserved at the logical end. Keep action controls shrinkable, retaining full accessible labels. An empty/whitespace static description object creates no surface-description association unless explicitly named; callbacks request association without probing output. Shorthand whitespace retains its existing presence policy. Raw HTML is unsupported.

### Examples (13)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Stage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/stage';

<Stage presentation="dialog"><Stage.Header title="Profile" description="Edit your details" action={<button>Help</button>} /></Stage>
```

### Type (6)

```ts
interface StageHeaderProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title" | "dangerouslySetInnerHTML" | "children">
```

### Members (7)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `StageHeaderProps.action` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Optional | — | Inner div slot for the caller's primary header action, before the separately owned Close button.<br>Prefer one visible command; an application-owned menu is allowed. No automatic dismissal,<br>child counting or menu conversion. Action and Close stay on one row, vertically centered<br>with the title/description block in every presentation and at narrow widths.<br>Omission removes the caller action region. Shorthand, native div props/ref and render callbacks remain supported.<br>When omitted, no caller action region is rendered; Close remains independently controlled. |
| `StageHeaderProps.closeLabel` | `string \| undefined` | Optional | — | Accessible close-button label. Overrides strings and the host resource; explicit empty/whitespace values are preserved.<br>When omitted, strings.closeLabel then the native SPFx resource supplies the label. |
| `StageHeaderProps.description` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot; caption1/subtle defaults with zero text gap. Literal strings (direct or props children) use at most two lines with ellipsis; JSX/callbacks own presentation. Full text remains accessible.<br>When omitted, no description region or accessible association is registered. |
| `StageHeaderProps.headingLevel` | `StageHeadingLevel \| undefined` | Optional | 2 | Title heading level; defaults to 2.<br>When omitted, the title wrapper is h2. |
| `StageHeaderProps.icon` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Inner span slot for a decorative 24px icon, hidden from assistive technology.<br>When omitted, no decorative icon region is rendered. |
| `StageHeaderProps.showCloseButton` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | true | Show the final close button; defaults to true. When hidden, provide a visible modal exit.<br>When omitted, the final Close button is visible. |
| `StageHeaderProps.strings` | `Partial<StageStrings> \| undefined` | Optional | — | Optional per-Header UI dictionary. Omitted/undefined members use the host-selected<br>native resource; explicit empty/whitespace strings are preserved. Direct closeLabel wins. |
| `StageHeaderProps.title` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Required | — | Required nonempty inner span slot; subtitle2/primary heading wrapper. Literal strings (direct or props children) use one line with ellipsis; JSX/callbacks own presentation. Full text remains accessible. |

## StageProps

Root contract with exclusive state ownership and presentation-specific options.
Presentation is latched for an open session; size updates live. A pending full Dialog/Drawer
retains the last compatible size of an active Popover until the next session.
Trigger must be a ref-capable native button or Fluent Button with an accessible name.
Uses the host Fluent theme, direction, document and Griffel renderer without an SPFx
provider. Put a DOM form inside the portaled surface when its footer submits that form.

### Imports (16)

```ts
import type { StageProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { StageProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { StageProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/stage';
```

### Semantics, portals and sizing

Dialog and Drawer are native modal surfaces; Popover is a nonmodal group without a focus trap. Stage owns surface roles and heading/description associations. Native focus placement/restoration and nested portal relationships remain Fluent-owned; removed triggers cannot restore focus. An explicit mountNode is caller-owned: verify its owner document, theme, direction, renderer styles and portal relationships. Stage adds no global renderer or arbitrary z-index. Dialog uses equal clamp(8px, 1vw, 16px) outer gaps, modal padding is 24px and Popover padding is 12px. Full Drawer reaches its viewport edge. Small viewport heights can scroll the whole surface so Header/Footer remain reachable.

### Dismissal and child popups

Controlled open accepts or refuses each permitted request; prop changes do not notify. Explicit mode filters native dismissal before notification but leaves trigger/Close requests. Child popup Escape consumption remains respected. The legacy compat DatePicker input consumes Escape even with its calendar closed, so close via X/footer or move focus first; Stage does not rewrite third-party key handlers.

### Form composition

Put a native form or Form.Root inside the portaled surface so footer submit controls share actual DOM form ownership. React context from a form outside the portal does not establish native form ownership. Preserve compatible flex layout in caller wrappers. Footer actions do not dismiss automatically.

### Examples (20)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Stage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/stage';

<Stage presentation="popover" trigger={<button>Details</button>}><Stage.Header title="Details" /><Stage.Body>Content</Stage.Body></Stage>
```

### Type (11)

```ts
type StageProps = StageCommonProps & StageStateProps & (
  | {
    /** Modal Dialog presentation; explicit and required. */
    presentation: 'dialog';
    /**
     * Width preset; defaults to small. Full fills both viewport dimensions with an outer gap.
     * When omitted, the width preset is small.
     * @defaultValue small
     */
    size?: StageSize;
    /**
     * Optional integrated accessible trigger; native ref and event handlers are preserved.
     * When omitted for Dialog/Drawer, open the controlled surface externally; Popover requires a trigger.
     */
    trigger?: React.ReactElement;
    /**
     * Drawer edge is unavailable for Dialog.
     * Omit this property in the selected presentation.
     */
    drawerPosition?: never;
    /**
     * Popover placement is unavailable for Dialog.
     * Omit this property in the selected presentation.
     */
    positioning?: never;
    /**
     * Popover arrow is unavailable for Dialog.
     * Omit this property in the selected presentation.
     */
    withArrow?: never;
  }
  | {
    /** Modal Drawer presentation; explicit and required. */
    presentation: 'drawer';
    /**
     * Width preset; defaults to small. Full fills available width.
     * When omitted, the width preset is small.
     * @defaultValue small
     */
    size?: StageSize;
    /**
     * Optional integrated accessible trigger; native ref and event handlers are preserved.
     * When omitted for Dialog/Drawer, open the controlled surface externally; Popover requires a trigger.
     */
    trigger?: React.ReactElement;
    /**
     * Logical edge; defaults to end.
     * When omitted in Drawer, the logical end edge is used.
     * @defaultValue end
     */
    drawerPosition?: StageDrawerPosition;
    /**
     * Popover placement is unavailable for Drawer.
     * Omit this property in the selected presentation.
     */
    positioning?: never;
    /**
     * Popover arrow is unavailable for Drawer.
     * Omit this property in the selected presentation.
     */
    withArrow?: never;
  }
  | {
    /** Nonmodal Popover presentation, opened by trigger click. */
    presentation: 'popover';
    /**
     * Preferred width: small 320px (default), medium 480px, large 640px.
     * Native positioning/auto-size bounds the rendered width to available viewport space.
     * Full is unsupported.
     * When omitted, the width preset is small.
     * @defaultValue small
     */
    size?: Exclude<StageSize, 'full'>;
    /** Required integrated accessible trigger; native ref and event handlers are preserved. */
    trigger: React.ReactElement;
    /**
     * Drawer edge is unavailable for Popover.
     * Omit this property in the selected presentation.
     */
    drawerPosition?: never;
    /**
     * Logical preferred placement; defaults to below/start.
     * When omitted in Popover, preferred placement is below/start.
     */
    positioning?: StagePopoverPositioning;
    /**
     * Show Fluent's native anchor arrow; defaults to false and updates while open.
     * When omitted in Popover, no arrow is shown.
     * @defaultValue false
     */
    withArrow?: boolean;
  }
)
```

## StageSize

Surface width preset. Defaults to small; full is unavailable for Popover.
Dialog widths are 640/800/1120px, Drawer 320/592/940px, Popover 320/480/640px.
Popover widths are preferred sizes; native auto-size reduces them to available viewport space.
Full fills the available viewport; Dialog retains its responsive outer gap.

## StageStateProps

Select controlled or uncontrolled ownership once for the component lifetime.
Uncontrolled state starts closed unless defaultOpen is true. Prop changes do not notify.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Examples (22)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Stage, StageProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/stage';
const stageProps = {
  presentation: 'dialog', defaultOpen: true,
  children: <><Stage.Header title="Details" /><Stage.Body>Initially open</Stage.Body></>,
} satisfies StageProps;
export function Details(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Stage {...stageProps} />;
}
```

### Type (13)

```ts
type StageStateProps = | {
    /** Authoritative controlled state; retain it to veto dirty/pending close requests. */
    open: boolean;
    /**
     * Unavailable when open is controlled.
     * Omit this property when open supplies controlled state.
     */
    defaultOpen?: never;
  }
  | {
    /** Omit open for uncontrolled state; changing ownership during mount is unsupported. */
    open?: never;
    /**
     * Initial uncontrolled state only; defaults to false.
     * Omit when open is controlled. Otherwise omission starts closed.
     */
    defaultOpen?: boolean;
  }
```

## StageStrings

Owned Stage UI labels. SPFx selects the native resource baseline without a toolkit provider.
Supply a partial dictionary to `Stage.Header.strings`. Omitted/undefined members use
that baseline; explicit empty and whitespace strings are preserved. Header's direct
`closeLabel` prop takes precedence. Caller title/description/action content is unchanged.

```ts
import type { StageStrings } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { StageStrings } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/stage';
```

## StageSurfaceAttributes

Native attributes forwarded to the surface div. Stage owns content and dialog semantics.
Consumer className and style remain escape hatches; refs are forwarded by Stage.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Examples (24)

```ts
import { StageProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/stage';
const attributes: Pick<StageProps, 'id' | 'aria-label'> = { id: 'editor', 'aria-label': 'Editor' };
```

### Type (14)

```ts
type StageSurfaceAttributes = Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>,
  'title' | 'children' | 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML' | 'role' | 'aria-modal' | 'aria-labelledby' | 'aria-describedby'>
```
